mapper.sql: id, user_id, package_id, usage_date, chat_count_used, daily_limit, last_chat_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_daily_usage (user_id, package_id, usage_date, chat_count_used, daily_limit, last_chat_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{packageId}, #{usageDate}, 1, #{dailyLimit}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE chat_count_used = chat_count_used + 1, last_chat_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user_daily_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY usage_date DESC
